recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
./gradlew assembleRelease
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
OUT=app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
reproducible-apk-tools/rm-files.py "$OUT" /outputs/unsigned.apk 'kotlin/*'
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --zipalign fix-newlines /outputs/unsigned.apk 'META-INF/services/*'
